title: arpitk12/agentic-ai-learning-plan
description: 12-week hands-on agentic AI learning plan: exercises, solutions, projects. Works with Ollama (local), Groq, Gemini, or any cloud LLM.

title: Shelpuk-AI-Technology-Consulting/kitty-bridge
description: Universal LLM bridge for AI agents. Use Claude Code with MiniMax, Codex with GLM, or Gemini CLI with OpenRouter — one command, any provider. Works with coding agents, OpenClaw, Hermes, and others.

title: Harshadshinde7620/QA-Agents
description: AI-powered QA Automation Agent built using Mistral LLM to generate, plan, and execute test cases from minimal inputs like screenshots or requirements. Designed with a modular multi-agent architecture to simulate real-world QA workflows including test generation, execution, and reporting.

title: synapseorch-ai/synapse-ai
description: Build AI agents that actually do things. Synapse is an open-source platform for creating, connecting, and orchestrating AI agents powered by any LLM — local, cloud or CLIs.

title: SakethramSathish/AI_Powered_Code_Review_Platform
description: CodeGuardian AI is an intelligent, agentic Code Review Platform built with FastAPI, Streamlit, and LangGraph. It ingests GitHub repositories or local files, orchestrating multiple LLM agents (powered by Gemma-4-31b-it) to concurrently analyze code quality, flag security vulnerabilities, gauge maintainability, and suggest architectural refactoring.

title: Dezz05/AuraSDK
description: Enable fast, local memory recall for AI agents using a lightweight, Rust-based cognitive memory engine with no cloud or LLM calls needed.

title: ShrutiShravani/GuardOps
description: GuardOps is production-grade MLOps middleware framework designed to wrap volatile, probabilistic AI layers (LLM Agents, RAG retrieval paths, or complex data extraction nodes) in a strict, deterministic software shield.

title: jfrog/agent-belt
description: Reproducible evaluation for AI coding agents. Multi-turn scenarios against Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Goose, OpenCode, or any custom agent you plug in; verify behavior with rule checks, workspace diffs, multi-judge LLM consensus; pin reliability with pass^k variance across trials. Git worktrees, optional Docker sandbox.

title: GhravenLabs/Agent-Meeting-Room
description: Flask multi-agent AI chat — @mention local LLMs (Ollama) or Claude into a live group chat with debate mode, SSE streaming, and Obsidian memory

title: stephonGAO/milu
description: Production-ready multi-user AI agent framework — 9 LLM providers with Chinese models (Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM) first-class. Built-in tools, MCP, RAG, sub-agents, skills, scheduler and an agent pool. Run it as a CLI/service, or embed it as a library.

title: XAIHT/Tlamatini
description: Tlamatini is a self-hosted AI developer assistant for local or cloud LLMs: hybrid RAG over your codebase, a 79-tool multi-turn engine, a 74-agent visual workflow designer, and ACPX, a runtime for external coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Gemini CLI.

title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm
description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.

title: Light-Heart-Labs/DreamServer
description: Turn your PC, Mac, or Linux box into an AI server.  LLM inference, chat UI, voice, agents, workflows, RAG, and image generation.

title: David405/harness-kit
description: Reusable harness engineering workflow for AI-assisted engineering — agent context files, sprint contracts, and review loops that work with any LLM or coding tool.

title: dadamsuk/browserhost
description: Run multiple real Chrome browsers on your desktop and drive them from elsewhere, perhaps an AI agent or an LLM CLI

title: YanAmorelli/universal-memory
description: A vendor-agnostic cognitive persistence layer for AI agents. Eliminate the "repetition tax" by transporting your context, preferences, and history across sessions. Features an auto-adaptation engine that syncs global instructions to ensure operational cohesion and optimize token usage across any LLM or multi-agent workflow.

title: 7yuling/ATEE
description: ATEE is a lightweight AI security agent plugin deployed on the website administrator's server or a security node within the same intranet. It connects to website requests through a thin adapter, delegates security judgments to the Core Service, and then uses a remote LLM API-driven ATEE Agent to judge and punish security cases.

title: anandtopu/mock-agents
description: Simulate, test, and validate AI agent integrations — without calling real LLMs or burning tokens.

title: MaiM0hamed/AI-Engineering-Book-Notes
description: A collection of my notes, reviews, and key learnings from the AI Engineering book.  As I progress through each chapter, I document the concepts that I found most interesting, challenging, or impactful in building real-world AI applications.  Topics include Foundation Models, LLM Evaluation, RAG, AI Agents, Fine-Tuning, Inference Optimization

title: skut264/Gideon
description: Gideon is a personal AI agent that lives on a cloud server, learns from conversations, uses tools, and can be powered by either a local LLM running on your own laptop or cloud AI APIs — your choice, depending on your budget and needs.
